title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Intake and Grille Bezels May Detach (3,096 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Anthem AN (4) and 2025-2027 Pioneer PR (4) vehicles. The intake and grille bezels may detach from the vehicle.

title: Airstream, Inc.: Fairing May Detach (91 affected)
summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Rangeline recreational vehicles. Inadequate adhesion may cause the fairing to detach.

title: KUAT INNOVATIONS LLC: Swing-Away Hitch Adapter Rear Cross Beam May Detach (3,845 affected)
summary: Kuat Innovations LLC ( Kuat) is recalling certain Pivot V3 swing-away hitch adapter with part numbers PV3D20B or PV3P20B. The hitch tube weld may crack, causing the cross beam to detach.
